build.sources: gitCommit plus the changes of the commit that adds or rewrites this metadata, rendered from that working tree before committing

comparison: Compared by tests/smoke/test_golden_room.cpp with G01's tolerance (6/255 per channel, at most 0.5% of the pixels) on this GPU and driver only.
description: Gate B golden of the P0 single-ROM room (style 26.1 6, style 21): the snes-single fixture's one ROM without any media, its cartridge face-out with a generated label, the room furnished from the template alone, the hero CRT showing the game's title card (no media: I5 step 1, ADR-0016 §8), from the doorway (the plan's scene camera).

image.format: PNG, 8-bit RGB, sRGB-encoded as the window shows it

fixture.name: esde/snes-single
fixture.rule: SHA-256 of the lines "<relative path>\t<SHA-256 of the file>\n", sorted by path

run.regenerate: $env:RV_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1; build/msvc-x64-debug/bin/rv_smoke_tests.exe "golden/G06:*"; Remove-Item Env:RV_UPDATE_GOLDEN (then run it again without the variable; tests/smoke/test_golden_room.cpp)
steps: a first run of the same command but --frames 300 and without --video-freeze-pts, --spawn or --input-script: the plan generated and written, the covers into the cache

view: the plan's scene camera at the doorway (no --spawn)
